name: Volunteer with the Montana Natural History Center
what_you_do: Help staff naturalists with kids' games, school field trips and summer camps. Or garden at Fort Missoula. Or greet visitors at the front desk.
who_can_apply: The page says it accepts volunteers of all ages and abilities. It does not list a teen rule.
pay_detail: Volunteer roles. No pay is mentioned.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Application form on the volunteer page, or stop by the center. Call 406-327-0405 to ask about age rules.
notes: Call to confirm the minimum age for the role you want. The page does not state one.
